tagline: A rapidly transforming European side district — formerly industrial, now a growing mix of tech offices, creative spaces, and new residential development.

items.name: Kağıthane Vadisi Kafeler
items.description: A growing café scene in the valley area popular with the district's tech and creative workers.

items.name: Kağıthane Vadisi
items.description: A valley park being developed as a green corridor through the district. A pleasant walking area amid the urban development.

tips: Kağıthane is on the M7 metro line (connect to the M2 at Mecidiyeköy), and the M11 airport line also stops here.
The district is transforming fast — tech companies and creative agencies are relocating here for affordable office space.
Better for working or living than visiting — not a leisure destination yet.
The valley park development will eventually make this a more liveable neighbourhood.
